version: dynamics-2026-10-16 (MVP1: unpowered; rolling bearings main, plain bearings comparison; general N-member chain for offset / split / knee designs; slaved coordinates from build.json)

model.frame: thorax rig frame (x anterior, y up, z right, origin GH); gravity -y
model.integrator: implicitfast, Newton, noslip 20 (exact Coulomb joint friction)
model.scapula: ball joint at GH, prescribed: body_pose.scap law with the 20 deg kink rounded over 1.5 deg (softplus)
model.arm: humerus follows the clip's followed pose p (PCHIP through the clip's knots), cuff on its axis

tissue.source: Schiebl et al. 2025, Sensors 25(15):4605 (upper-arm interface, median stiffness); damping assumed

model.mvp1: unpowered (user, 2026-10-15): every joint passive, no motor / gear / cable; motor and servo cases exist only as --cases options

cuff_pressure.rule: mean pressure = cuff force / skin-side shell area; the budget left for the exo is COMFORT - STRAP (edge peaks ~2x the mean)

contact.rule: every member pair incl. adjacent ones; at a shared joint the bearing (hub on hub, hub on the other member's hub-side ribbon root) is the hinge, not a contact

load_friction.model: tau_f,i = tau0 + mu_eff |M_perp,i| each step (red team G6, pipeline/redteam/rt_wedge.py); M_perp from cfrc_int one step behind

rolling.basis: pair of shielded deep-groove / needle bearings at the hub, bore d ~10 mm, spacing L ~5 mm: the tilt couple is a force couple M/L, SKF simplified friction M_f = 0.5 mu P d per bearing (mu 0.0015 deep groove, 0.0025 needle) -> mu_eff = mu d / L = 0.003-0.005; tau0 = grease drag of 2 shielded bearings

load_friction.tilt_ref_note: hub: moment about the hub stack's mid-height on the axis (the pin carries the force); gh: about the GH centre, rt_wedge.py's model without R x F

chain.kind: general serial chain from the clips' own member frames (dynamics-2026-10-16): base -> l1a -> l1b -> l2 -> l3 -> l4 -> arm
chain.slaved_rule: joint equality on the declared law's tangent, re-linearised every step; force closure = unilateral (on while the drive pushes); drive bodies lumped on their mount; drive bearing friction not modelled
chain.arm_member: the humerus (canonical frame at GH), joined to the last member by its hinge and to the bone by the soft-tissue cuff
chain.contact: member-member contact not modelled in the general chain (R6 judges part interference geometrically: 0.0 mm on these designs); stops are joint limits
notes: the knee stop (149.5 deg) is not in the CAD and not modelled; the knee pins are free
joint friction on every hinge incl. K and the knee pins (rolling-bearing law; iglidur knee pins share it - an optimistic note for the plain-bearing pins, see the plain-bearing comparison cases)
bearing centre for the load-dependent friction = the hinge's anchor at the hub stack centre (not a point on a GH ray)

verdict.rule: moves freely: |M_GH| peak <= 1.0 N.m and rms <= 0.5, cuff force <= 5.0 N, cuff twist <= 5.0 deg, no stall missing >= 10.0 deg of planned joint travel, 4R spare drift <= 5.0 deg, a slaved joint within 5.0 deg of its law; drives: never |M_GH| > 10.0 N.m or cuff force > 150.0 N (ISO/TS 15066 upper arm)

m5_forward_bound.method: the alignment skeptic's forward-stroke bound (docs/alignment/slipper-nose-knuckle-3r.md, skeptic 14:20): clock-spring preload AND rate de-rated by 1/eta (eta 0.851 = the worst-PA efficiency at mu 0.120): preload 0.094 N.m, rates (0.015, 0.010)/eta; judge/dynamics.py unchanged, run through an in-process wrapper (K_RATES), --quick --no-validate --general --jobs 1, on a scratch copy of this design dir with design.json build_fixes.spring.preload set
